description: Core mathematics education principles used to explain why different systems teach concepts differently.

principles.description: A progression where students first experience mathematical ideas using objects, then visual representations, before moving to symbols and formal procedures.
Students develop deep understanding of a concept before moving forward, with attention to misconceptions and multiple representations.
Students compare carefully selected examples and non-examples to identify mathematical structures and relationships.
Students explain, justify and communicate mathematical thinking rather than only produce answers.
Students develop efficient and accurate mathematical procedures while understanding when and why to use them.
